subject: planner: reuse slices with buildKeyInfo (#62525)
summary:
Diff scope (vs first parent) only changes `pkg/planner/core/rule/rule_build_key_info.go` to reuse a pooled `[]*expression.Schema` when calling `LogicalPlan.BuildKeyInfo`, plus Bazel dep on `//pkg/util/zeropool`. The new slice construction preserves child order and produces `len(childSchema)==len(lp.Children())`; a `defer` returns the slice to the pool after `BuildKeyInfo` returns.

Correctness/concurrency check: all `LogicalPlan.BuildKeyInfo(selfSchema, childSchema)` implementations in `pkg/planner/core/operator/logicalop/*` only read `childSchema` and do not retain/modify it beyond the call, so pooling does not introduce aliasing/corruption; `zeropool` is sync.Pool-based and concurrency-safe. Checked later history to `upstream/master` for this file; subsequent changes are unrelated refactors (portal removal/trace cleanup), no follow-up correctness fix indicated.
